tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /'byung bzhi'i gtor chog bzhugs/na mo gu ru we/'byung bzhi'i gtor ma gtong bar 'dod pas/bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi'o/ /
༄༅/ /'byung bzhi'i gtor chog bzhugs/na mo gu ru we/'byung bzhi'i gtor ma gtong bar 'dod pas/bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi'o/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'byung bzhi'i gtor chog bzhugs/ na mo gu ru we/

'byung bzhi'i gtor ma gtong bar 'dod pas/ bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'gro ba'i don du sangs rgyas myur thob shog / ces skyabs sems sngon du song nas/ oṃ badzra amṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bha wa shuddha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ zhes pas stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ las rang nyid pha dam pa sangs rgyas sku mdog smug nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas seng ldeng gis ḍā ma ru nam mkha' la 'khrol ba/ g.yon dngul dkar gyi dril bu 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i dkyil krung du bzhugs pa/ rten 'brel ky-i gi la te 'phrag par bkal ba/ gdams ngag gis mdzod 'dzin pa/ bka' bstan bcos thams cad thugs la tshang ba/ zhal du ā li ka li'i sgra sgrog pa/ sprul pa'i sku mi pham mgon po dam pa rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ ā/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ta tha da dha na/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha kṣa/ zhes ci mang bzlas la/ de nas gtor ma la/ oṃ badzra amṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bha wa shuddha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las bhruṃ las rin po che las grub pa'i snod zab cing rgya cheb ba'i nang du/ yaṃ las rlung rdzas sngon po yangs shing g.yo bar 'gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum/ yaṃ i ī tsa tsha dza dzha nya ya sha / zhes nyer gcig sogs bzlas/ arghaṃ nas shapta 'i bar gyis mchod nas/ yaṃ las rlung rdzas sngon po yangs shing g.yo bar gyur pa 'di nyid bla ma dang*/ shar rdo rje sems dpa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo/ /bzhes nas snang ba brten 'brel du 'char bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rten 'brel gyi sgo nas 'gro don nus par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

'gro don gyi 'khor ba dong nas dkrug nus par gyur cig /nyon mongs pa zhe sdang zhi bar gyur cig /nang rlung nad zhi bar gyur cig / gdon lha'i gdon zhi bar gyur cig /shar phyogs dri za'i gdon zhi bar gyur cig /bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'gro ba'i don du sangs rgyas myur thob shog / skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhruṃ las rin po che las grub pa'i snod zab cing rgya che ba'i nang du/ /raṃ las me rdzas dmar po tsha zhing bsreg par gyur cig / oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum/ raṃ ṛ ṝ ṭa ṭha ḍha ṇa ra ṣa/ nyer gcig bzlas/ arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ raṃ las me rdzas dmar po tsha zhing bsreg pa 'di nyid bla ma dang lho'i rin chen 'byung ldan gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo/ /bzhes nas snang ba rten 'brel du 'char bar gyur cig / rten 'brel gyi sgo nas 'gro don nus par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ 'gro don gyis 'khor ba dong nas dkrug nus par gyur cig /nyon mongs pa nga rgyal dang ser sna zhi bar gyur cigand tsha nad zhi bar gyur cig /gdon pho gdon zhi bar gyur cig /lho phyogs gshin rjes gnod pa zhi bar gyur cig / gong bzhin skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya/ oṃ badzra amṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bha wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhruṃ las rin po che las grub pa'i snod zab cing rgya che ba'i nang du*/ baṃ las chu rdzas dkar po grang zhing gsher bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum/ baṃ u ū pa pha ba bha ma wa kṣa/ arghaṃ= sogs kyis mchod/ baṃ las chu rdzas dkar po grang zhing gsher bar gyur pa 'di nyid bla ma dang*/ nub snang ba mtha' yas kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo/ /bzhes nas snang ba rten 'brel du 'char bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /rten 'brel gyi sgo nas 'gro don nus par byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/

'gro don gyi 'khor ba dong nas dkrug nus par gyur cig /nyon mongs pa 'dod chags zhi bar gyur cig /nad grang nad zhi bar gyur cig /gdon mo gdon zhi bar gyur cig /nub phyogs chu lha'i gnod pa zhi bar gyur cig / skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swā bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhruṃ las rin po che las grub pa'i snod zab cing rgya che ba'i nang du/ paṃ las sa rdzas ser po sra zhing mthas par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan gsum/ laṃ l̥ l̥̄ ta tha da dha na las/ arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ laṃ las sa rdzas ser po sra zhing 'thas par gyur pa 'di nyid bla ma dang byang don yod grub pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo/ /bzhes nas snang ba brten 'brel du 'char bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /rten 'brel gyi sgo nas 'gro don nus par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ / 'gro don gyi 'khor ba dong nas dkrug nus par gyur cig /nyon mongs pa gti mug zhi bar gyur cig /nad bad kan zhi bar gyur cig /gdon pa gdon zhi bar gyur cig /byang phyogs gnod sbyin gyi gnod pa zhi bar gyur cig /oṃ badzra amṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhruṃ las rin po che las grub pa'i snod zab cing rgya che ba'i nang du/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma gzugs glud chang bu 'theb skyu dang bcas pa 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te/ oṃ sambha ra sambha ra hūṃ/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma gzugs glud chang bu 'theb skyu dang bcas pa 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid bdag cag yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pas/ tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas da lta'i bar du/ brgyab pa'i nad mang bsad pa'i tshe thung*/ 'phrog pa'i sgong bul zas nor srog gi lan chags dang*/

gzhan yang mtho ba mkhar gyi lan chags dang*/ dma' ba sa zhing gi lan chags dang*/ mu tig gser dngul zangs lcags kyi lan chags dang*/ nor g.yag rta lug gsum gyi lan chags dang*/ phyugs ba ra bong gsum gyi lan chags dang*/ yul mi khyim mtshes kyis lan chags dang*/ pha ma bu tsha'i lan chags la sogs pa lan chags kyi rigs su gyur pa rnams la sbyin no/ /tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i lan chags thams cad byang sha 'khon thams cad zhi/ bu lon thams cad khyer nas phan tshun byams pa la gnas par gyur cig / kyai srid gsum 'di na gang yang rung*/ /'di na gnas pa'i gdon bgegs rnams/ /tshur shog rgyal ba'i bka' la nyon/ /'bru mchog ngar glud ya mtshan can/ /sngon tshe lha dbang brgya byin glud/ /da lta yon bdag rgyu 'byor glud/ /glud bdag thams cad glud bzhes shig /yas kyi bdag por yas bzhes cig / bdag sogs yon bdag 'khor bcas kyi/ /sha yi glud 'di sa la gtong*/ /sa la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams/ /glud dang gtor ma 'di longs la/ /yongs la gnod pa ma byed cig /khrag gi glud 'di chu la gtong*/ /chu la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams/ /glud dang gtor ma 'di longs la/ /yongs la gnod pa ma byed cig/ drod kyi glud 'di me la gtong*/ /me la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams/ /glud dang gtor ma 'di longs la/ /yongs la gnod pa ma byed cig /dbugs kyi glud kyi rlung la gtong*/ /rlung la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams/ /glud dang gtor ma 'di longs la/ /yongs la gnod pa ma byed cig /yid kyi glud 'di mkha' la gtong*/ /mkha' la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams/ /glud dang gtor ma 'di longs la/ /yongs la gnod pa ma byed cig /sngon tshe bden pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ /da lta rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi /bsam pa rnam par dag pa dang*/ /rnal 'byor don gnyis ldan pa yi/ /lhag bsam dag pa'i bsam pa yis/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ khram la bab na khram kha phyes/

/shwa la bab na shor rdo dor/ /rtsis la bab na rtsis te phyung*/ /rgyan la bab na rgyan de spos/ /bzung ba thongs la bcings pa bkrol/ /bdud kyi zhags pa slar bsgyur cig / gzhan yang bzlog pa'i rigs ci rigs bya'o/ /yang dam pa sangs rgyas 'gro ba'i mgon po'i 'byung bzhi'i gtor ma 'di nyid nad pa drag po'i bzlog tu gtong na/ lha bshos dbul zan zla gam brgya dang lnga shar du bltas la btang*/ gru gsum brgya dang gsum lhor bltas la btang*/ zlum po brgya dang drug nub tu bltas la btang*/ gru bzhi brgya dang bzhi byang du bltas la btang*/ ngar glud brgya/ 'theb skyu brgya/ chang bu brgya/ zan mi'i glud pho mo gang yin gyi skye mched dod par byas la/ de'i phrag pa g.yas pa mi kha'i rdzas bkal/ g.yon la nad pa'i lo grangs kyi khram shing bkal ba gcig /nad pa'i gos kyi thu ba g.yas pa'i steng du bzhag la kha rang la bstan/ de'i mdun du snod zangs chen mo bzhag la/ skyabs sems dang*/ bdag bskyed/ lha bshos zla gam sogs gong gi rigs 'dre/ ngar glud chang bu sogs kha 'bar ma'i rigs 'dre/ bsngos zin pa dang thebs gang yod du bskyal/ bden pa'i stobs rnams brjod/ rjes bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngo'o/ /lhag chad yi ge brgya pa bzla'o/ / gzhan yang 'di skad do/ / kyai gson cig snang srid lha 'dre rnams/ /glud 'di srid pa gang nas srid/ /dang po bcom ldan shaka thub kyis/ lha dbang brgya byin don du mdzad/ /bar du 'khor lo drug pa'i glud/ /'du ba rnam bzhi nad las grol/ /da lta rgyu sbyor yon bdag glud/ /rnal 'byor sngags 'chang bdag gis ni/ /sde brgyad rnams la btang ba yi/ /bar chad ma lus zhi bar byas/ /ngar glud gser gyi a tsa ra/ /zer mos sgros la lung thang mig /spyan mig phrad ngas hrig se hrig /mgron bu'i so ni dkar mdangs can/ /zhal ni 'dzum mdangs mu lu lu/ /phyag g.yas rin chen gser la byas/

/g.yon pa rin chen g.yu la byas/ / phyag gi gar stabs ling se ling*/ /zhabs g.yas thabs chen lcags la byas/ / g.yon pa shes rab zangs la byas/ /zhabs kyi gar 'gros 'du ru ru/ /rnam shes tshogs drug 'di la tshang*/ /bkrag mdangs gzi mdangs 'di la tshang*/ /sha khrag rus gsum 'di la tshang*/ /longs spyod mnga' thang 'di la tshang*/ /dpa' stsal stobs rgyas 'di la tshang*/ /'gro na khyu mchog ma he'i 'gros/ /smra na tshangs pa'i dbyangs ltar smras/ /rin chen sna lnga'i rgyan gyis brgyan/ /dar mtshon sna lnga'i na bza' gsol/ /'ja' tshon sna lnga'i 'od zer 'phros/ /'di 'dra'i glud mchog ya mtshan can/ /mi las de ni glud dga'o/ /bya las de ni spu dga'o/ / snang srid lha 'dre'i phyag tu 'bul/ /bzhes nas rang rang gnas su gshegs/ / kyai da ni 'byung ba glud gtong ngo*/ /gtor glud 'byung ba lnga la gtong*/ /lam ni bla med gnas su ston/ /'du ba dang po sems ky-i glud/ /'byung ba dang po nam mkhar gtong*/ /nam mkhar gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams/ /glud dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bzung ba thongs la bcing ba bkrol/ /phyin chad gnod pa ma byed cig /'du ba de ni dbugs kyi glud/ /'byung ba de ni rlung la gtong*/ /rlung la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams/ /glud dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bzung ba thongs la bcing ba bkrol/ /phyin chad gnod pa ma byed cig /'du ba de na drod kyis glud/ /'byung ba de ni me la gtong*/ /me la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams/ glud dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bzung ba thongs la bcing ba bkrol/ /phyin chad gnod pa ma byed cig /'du ba de ni khrag gi glud/ /'byung ba de ni chu la gtong*/ /chu la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams/ /glud dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ / bzung ba thongs la bcing ba bkrol/ /phyin chad gnod pa ma byed cig /'du ba de ni sha yi glud/ /'byung ba de ni sa la gtong*/ /sa la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams/ /glud dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la/

/bzung ba thongs la bcing ba bkrol/ /phyin chad gnod pa ma byed cig /'du ba de ni rus pa'i glud/ /'byung ba de ni brag la gtong*/ /brag la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams/ glud dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bzung ba thongs la bcing ba bkrol/ /phyin chad gnod pa ma byed cig /'du ba de ni rtsa rgyus glud/ /'byung ba de ni shing la gtong*/ /shing la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams/ /glud dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bzung ba thongs la bcings pa bkrol/ /phyin chad gnod pa ma byed cig /'du ba de ni pags pa'i glud/ /'byung ba de ni thang la gtong*/ /thang la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams/ / glud dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bzung ba thongs ba bcing ba bkrol/ /phyin chad gnod pa ma byed cig /'du ba ni rgyu ma'i glud/ /'byung ba de ni lam la gtong*/ /lam la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams/ /glud dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bzung ba thongs ba bcing ba bkrol/ /phyin chad gnod pa ma byed cig / 'du ba de ni skra yi glud/ /'byung ba de ni nags la gtong*/ /nags la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams/ /glud dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /bzung ba thongs la bcing ba bkrol/ /phyin chad gnod pa ma byed cig / de nas glud gar gtong phyogs la kha bstan la 'di skad do/ / kyai da ni glud la lam cig ston/ /yang dag don gyi lam dang gcig / kun rdzob sgyu ma'i lam dang gnyis/ /yang dag don gyi lam ston pa/ /chos nyid stong pa'i lam du bstan/ /kun rdzob sgyu ma'i lam bstan pa/ /'byung ba lnga yi lus stobs kyi/ /ma bsgrod bsam pa tsam gyis ni/ /stong gsum gzhan du sleb par bzhud/ /longs spyod sna tshogs de na che/ /bgegs kyi rgyal po de na bzhugs/ /da ni glud la lam cig ston/ /lam ni dgung sngon mthongs su ston/ / dgung tshig skya mo dung gi lam/ /lam der bzhud la mkha' la gshegs/ /yang ni glud la lam cig ston/ /lam ni chu bo'i gzhung la ston/

/chu gzhung sngon mo chu yi lam/ /lam 'di bzhud la phyogs der gshegs/ /yang ni glud la lam cig ston/ /lha klu gnod sbyin 'byung po rnams/ /so so'i lam ni bsam mi khyab/ / lam der bzhud la tshur ma log /chos nyid bden pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ / gsang sngags bka' yi byin rlabs dang*/ /sngags 'chang bdag gi byin rlabs kyi/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod ldan par shog /lan chags rgyal po bgegs kyi tshogs/ /glud dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /yongs la gnod pa ma byed par/ khyod kyi nad rnams myur du bsdus/ khram la bab na khram kha phyes/ /sho la bab na sho rde'u dor/ /rtsis la bab na rtsis te phyung*/ /rgyan la bab na rgyan de spos/ /so so'i gnas dang rten la gshegs/ /phyin chad 'di la gnod ma byed/ /glud chen dam pa 'di khyer la/ /nad god tsha god khyod kyis chod/ /na ba'i na khur khyod kyis thon/ /tsha ba'i tsha khur khyod kyis thon/ /bsdams pa yod na glod la thongs// bcing ba yod na khrol la thongs/ /chags chen nyams nga bzlog tu gsol/ /rmi lam mtshan ltas ngan pa bzlog /mthu gtad rbod gtong thams cad bzlog / bdud kyi zhags pa slar bsgyur cig /de rjes dge ba byang chub tu bsngo'o/ /

smon lam dang*/ bkra shis bya'o/ /'byung bzhi'i gtor chog 'di yang gtor chog rnying pa la tā ra na thās zhu dag bgyis pa te byin rlabs ky-i gzi 'od 'bar ba nad gdon rab zhi zhes pa'o// //maṅga laṃ// ༈ mi kha'i rdzas la/ re ba nag po'i khug ma'i nang du/ zan dang bra bo sgog pa gsum/ btsong dang yongs ma zhun mkhan gsum/ /sgyed drag pha 'ong drag pa bslang*/ rtag gsum 'gal ba sne nag bya gsob rnams/ mi kha bzlog pa'i rdzas su bsags/ thang dkar gyi pho tang*/ glang mas mo tang lag pa g.yas g.yon bku/ / ༈ sran ma/ bra bo/ ram pa/ brtsod/ mtshur/ tshwa/ g.yer ma/ sbang ma/ yos tshig /ra bal/ khyi bal/ skra tshal/ sgog pa/ rdo nag /g.yag rwa/ ra rmigakhyi mgo /ra thod/ bra shing*/ glang ma/ sgyu mo/ bo to phub chag /mda' chagamadung chag /gzhu chag /gri chag /sder chag /phor chag /gzar chag /stan dum/ lham dum/ de rnams blug /rdzogs so// // bkra shis// gcig zhus// de yang skye 'di nyid nas rab bsags pa/ /bya ba don ldan kho na'i mthu la brten/ /gdos byas rgyu las 'di gang bor ma thag /'khor bar skye gnas dman pa kun las ldog/dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/tā ra nā tha'i gsung thor bu'i skor/ - PAGE 44 -- PAGE 43 -- PAGE 35 -
